info.name: PlaceTrack API
info.description:
Postman collection for the PlaceTrack Placement Management System (Spring Boot backend).

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:8080).

AUTHENTICATION: the backend uses a DB-backed session token sent in the X-Auth-Token header (no Bearer scheme). Run 'Authentication > Login' (or Register) first - its test script saves the returned token field into the {{token}} collection variable, which every protected request uses automatically.

ERRORS: validation errors return 400 with a fieldErrors map; unknown ids return 404; missing/expired tokens return 401; duplicate emails return 409.

request.description: POST /api/auth/register - creates an account (password is BCrypt-hashed) and returns a UserResponse containing the session token. Roles: STUDENT (default), PLACEMENT_OFFICER or ADMIN. Duplicate email returns 409.

exec: pm.test('Register returns user fields and token', function () {

request.description: POST /api/auth/login - verifies credentials and returns a UserResponse whose token field is the session token. Wrong credentials return 401.
POST /api/auth/logout - invalidates the session token sent in the X-Auth-Token header. Returns 204 No Content.

exec: pm.test('Logout returns 204 No Content', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
